meta.scope: Philippines Batch 10 — Mining/minerals (nickel focus), fisheries/aquaculture, and ports/shipping statistics.

candidates.title: Mining and quarrying production statistics
candidates.publisher: Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR) / PSA related
candidates.description: Official statistics on metallic and non-metallic mineral production. Nickel is the standout commodity (Philippines ranks among the world’s top producers); gold, copper and others complete the main metallic output.
candidates.notes: Core mining statistical product. Nickel gives the Philippines a distinctive position in global battery/EV mineral supply chains.

candidates.title: Nickel production and export statistics
candidates.description: Focused statistics on nickel output and trade. The Philippines has been the second-ranked global producer in recent years, making nickel a high-centrality commodity node.
candidates.notes: High-centrality commodity uniqueness node (parallel to Indonesian nickel but different institutional and policy context).

candidates.title: Fisheries and aquaculture production statistics
candidates.description: Official volume and value of production for capture fisheries and aquaculture (milkfish, tilapia and other species prominent). Complements the broader agriculture and food-security cluster.

candidates.title: Port and shipping statistics (cargo, containers, passengers)
candidates.description: Operational statistics on cargo throughput (MMT), container volume (TEUs), shipcalls and passenger traffic at Philippine ports. Captures both domestic inter-island and foreign trade flows.
candidates.notes: Core maritime-logistics node for an archipelagic economy.

candidates.title: Inter-island transport and connectivity framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from PPA, transport and regional sources
candidates.description: Policy and statistical framing of inter-island shipping, passenger and cargo connectivity that links Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. Complements the ports statistics and the regional economic structure nodes.
candidates.notes: Domestic-integration counterpart to the international trade and ports nodes.

candidates.title: Philippines mining–fisheries–ports densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MGB, PSA and PPA sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding mining/quarrying statistics, nickel production and trade, fisheries/aquaculture production, port/shipping operations and inter-island connectivity framing into a coherent resources–food–logistics layer.
